name: MenuItem
description: A row in a menu, dropdown or sidebar. Renders the element that matches what it does — an anchor for `href`, a real button for `onClick`, a div otherwise — so keyboard and assistive-technology behaviour comes from the platform. Supports optional icons, active state and a pill shape.
usage: Use within lists or navigation structures.
Provide `href` to render as an internal Next.js link.
Use `onClick` for non-navigation actions; the item renders as a `<button>`.
Set `isActive` to true to apply active styling; links also receive `aria-current="page"`.
Pass icon components (e.g., from lucide-react) to `LeftIcon` or `RightIcon`.
Use `size` ('sm', 'md', 'lg') to control overall item size, including text and icons.
`rightContent` keeps the item a `<div>` even with `onClick`, since that slot usually holds its own buttons.
Use `iconSize` and `iconStrokeWidth` when the icon should not inherit the text size or lucide's default weight.
Set `radius` from the nested-radius rule: the container's radius minus the inset between it and the row. Equal radii on parent and child widen the gap at the corners.
examples:
```tsx
// rightContent holds its own buttons, so the row stays a <div>
<MenuItem onClick={load} rightContent={<Button size="xs" Icon={Pencil} iconOnly aria-label="Edit" />}>Preset</MenuItem>
```

```tsx
// Body-sized text with small, hairline icons
import { ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
<MenuItem size="lg" iconSize="sm" iconStrokeWidth={1.5} RightIcon={ChevronRight} onClick={open}>
  Settings
</MenuItem>
```

```tsx
// A menu on --radius-xl padded by --space-2xs: rows take radius 'sm'
<MenuItem size="xl" radius="sm" iconSize="sm" href="/journal">Journal</MenuItem>
```
design: Use consistent text sizes within a single menu structure.
Ensure icons clearly relate to the menu item's action or destination.
Active state should clearly differentiate the selected item.
Maintain sufficient padding and spacing for readability and touch targets.
Menus are drawn on `surface-section`. Hover fills with `surface-canvas` — a rung down the ramp, so the row reads as pressed into the surface rather than lifted off it.

Whatever the hover fill, it must differ from the surface the menu is drawn on. Hover previously used `surface-section`, the same token as its own container, and so was invisible on every menu that used it.

Icons are an affordance, not the content. Where the text is large, `iconSize` can hold them smaller, and `iconStrokeWidth` can match the surrounding rule weight — align their outer edge with any control in the menu's header rather than with the text.
Row inset is the dropdown-item recipe: --space-xs horizontal, --space-2xs vertical.
accessibility: The rendered element follows the item's behaviour: `href` gives an `<a>` via next/link, `onClick` gives a `<button>`, and neither gives a `<div>`. Interactive items are therefore focusable and operable by keyboard without added `role` or `tabIndex`.
The focus-visible ring is applied to whichever element receives focus. A previous version wrapped a styled div in a bare anchor, which left link items focusable with no visible indicator.
`isActive` sets `aria-current="page"` on link items so the current destination is announced, not merely coloured.
Long labels truncate rather than overflow; make sure the full text is available elsewhere if it carries meaning.
Icons are decorative and marked `aria-hidden`; if a row's text is ambiguous, provide an `aria-label`.
Ensure sufficient contrast between text, icons and background, especially in active and hover states.

props.name: children
props.description: The text content of the menu item.

props.name: LeftIcon
props.description: Optional Lucide icon name (e.g., 'Home') to display on the left.

props.name: RightIcon
props.description: Optional Lucide icon name (e.g., 'ChevronRight') to display on the right.

props.name: rightContent
props.description: Content slot on the right, such as action buttons. Clicks are isolated from the item's own onClick, and its presence keeps the row a <div> so buttons are not nested.

props.name: isActive
props.description: Whether the menu item is currently active/selected. Link items also receive aria-current="page".

props.name: href
props.description: If provided, renders the item as an internal Next.js Link.

props.name: size
props.description: Text step for the row, which icons follow unless iconSize overrides it. sm/md/lg map to label-sm, label and body; xl maps to heading-4, for a menu that is a view's primary navigation rather than a list of secondary actions.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius as a token step. Per the nested-radius rule, a row's radius is its container's radius minus the inset between them — a menu on --radius-xl (12px) padded by --space-2xs (8px) wants 'sm' (4px).

props.name: iconSize
props.description: Icon scale, when it should not follow the text size. Body-sized rows with 24px icons read as icon-led, when the icon is usually only an affordance.

props.name: iconStrokeWidth
props.description: Stroke weight passed through to the icons. Lighter values suit menus whose other rules are hairlines.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the menu item's container element.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Handler for click events. Without `href` or `rightContent`, the item renders as a `<button>`.
